summary: Amneal Pharmaceuticals filed an 8-K on April 22, 2026, announcing its agreement to acquire 100% of Kashiv BioSciences. Consideration includes $375M cash and 28,942,108 shares of Class A common stock (implied total value not explicitly stated; equity component depends on Amneal's stock price), plus up to $350M in regulatory milestones and potential 12-year royalty payments. The Independent Committee of independent directors unanimously approved the deal. No specified premium or expected closing date; transaction is subject to conditions. Watch for stock-price volatility and regulatory milestone triggers.
